head: a96079dc0f0ee5aadb8bcd07f4fce7a434a12227
scope: Exact three-file native-scope leak-capability diff plus existing owner installer, grants and native-scope RLS declaration. Uncommitted Native EMPTY files were not considered or activated.
expected: The final fresh-command check must refuse any return_native_scope row with current pg_backend_pid() and txid_current(), without filtering by actor/request or accepting an RLS-hidden leak.
The owning outer role cp7_credit_write receives only EXECUTE on a no-argument void assertion; return_native_scope remains postgres-owned, RLS-denied, with no added table privilege.
Current-authority checks, completed-receipt proof, ambient-scope refusal, own outer-scope deletion, persisted response and actual final closure ordering must remain unchanged.

observed.evidence: coordinator/07 new assert_return_native_scope_cleared_v1 has the same EXISTS predicate and CP7_CREDIT_NATIVE_SCOPE_NOT_CLEARED exception as both removed inline blocks. It is no-argument, returns void, PL/pgSQL VOLATILE SECURITY DEFINER, empty search_path and UTC.
observed.assessment: Exact current-backend/current-transaction refusal retained, including a mismatched actor/request leak.

observed.evidence: 07 private-functions loop explicitly changes the new helper owner to postgres. Existing installer _finalize_private_owners also assigns postgres to all fresh private functions except its exact three exceptions; this helper is not an exception. return_native_scope is explicitly postgres-owned in 07 and is not in PRIVATE_TABLE_OWNERS exceptions. admission/01 enables RLS without FORCE; finalizer installs explicit PUBLIC false policy only when no policy exists.
observed.assessment: The assertion reads as the owning postgres role and does not run its EXISTS under cp7_credit_write RLS filtering.

observed.evidence: 07 adds only EXECUTE on the new helper to cp7_credit_write; its private loop revokes PUBLIC/anon/authenticated/service_role/cp7_capture/cp7_sales_read/cp7_sales_write. Installer also removes outsider schema/function privileges. No diff adds a return_native_scope table grant; installer grants SELECT only on return_requests/return_command_scope to postgres and nine server-column UPDATE rights on return_command_scope.
observed.assessment: No new table-read/write capability or caller-chosen predicate. Existing credit-writer schema USAGE and its exact helper EXECUTE remain sufficient.

observed.evidence: Both wrappers replace only their inline EXISTS/RAISE with PERFORM assertion. The helper remains after completed-receipt validation and a current-authority equality check, before ambient-scope refusal, outer-scope delete and response UPDATE. coordinator/08 retains close_completed_return_receipt_v1 after response persistence and the final authority check. Replay branch is untouched.
observed.assessment: No authority, cleanup, response or closure ordering change.

observed.evidence: SQL_FILES loads 07 before the replacing 08 body; PL/pgSQL admission wrapper declaration can reference the later helper. 07 owner/revoke loop includes the helper, and _private_inventory captures every new-schema function definition SHA, owner, SECURITY DEFINER/volatility/config/ACL as well as table owner/RLS/policies/ACL, then compares it during verify.
observed.assessment: The helper is included in existing whole private inventory and finalization rather than silently omitted from owner/ACL handling.

scenarios.scenario: No row for current backend/current transaction
scenarios.expected: Void assertion completes; it does not modify any table. All later ambient and closure checks still execute.
scenarios.observed: EXISTS false falls through empty function end; no DML present. Source-only.

scenarios.scenario: One leaked scope row for current backend/current transaction, arbitrary actor or request
scenarios.observed: Exact predicate has no actor/request filter and raises unchanged exception. Source-only.

scenarios.scenario: Rows exist only for another backend or a different transaction
scenarios.expected: This exact current-scope assertion does not reject them; existing deferred/global contracts remain untouched.
scenarios.observed: Both backend and transaction predicates preserved with AND. Source-only.

scenarios.scenario: cp7_credit_write attempts direct table SELECT versus calls the assertion
scenarios.expected: No direct table permission added; the granted void SECURITY DEFINER assertion can inspect the owning-role view.
scenarios.observed: Only helper EXECUTE is added, helper and table owned postgres; no SELECT grant on native scope. No SQL execution performed.

scenarios.scenario: Authority changes during earlier request/source/Native waits
scenarios.expected: Existing fresh authority checks still reject before/after finalization as applicable.
scenarios.observed: Diff does not touch any return_command_access checks or their ordering; helper performs only a current-scope read.

checks: exact old predicate/error preserved in new helper
no-argument void VOLATILE SECURITY DEFINER with pinned search_path/UTC
completed-receipt and authority checks precede helper
helper precedes ambient check, scope delete and response update

limitations: No database/Native execution, role-grant runtime test or independent audit claim. Actual installer execution and runtime results remain for the parent integrator. No product modifications or child agents.
